entities.summary: Garry Lewis Templeton is an American former professional baseball player and minor league manager. He was a shortstop in Major League Baseball for the St. Louis Cardinals, San Diego Padres and New York Mets from 1976 to 1991. He was inducted into the Padres Hall of Fame. He managed in the minor and independent leagues from 1998 to 2013.
